notes.title: KRZ大作正式版就要可以下载了！
notes.content:
The official version of krz can be purchased and downloaded after March 11. If you don't want to spend money, you can come to the group to play the trial version (compared with the official version, there are less boss in Chapter 1 and Chapter 2, and more high-level copies and skills)
QQ group: 715375049
There is a list of ontology and patches that need to be downloaded for the beta version in the group announcement.
(official version and test version are common)
PS: at that time, some rookies will complain that the game is too difficult. They can't play anything at the beginning: remember, slim is very weak and can't hammer anything to death, but they can eat magic grass at the beginning. First upgrade, find some equipment, and upgrade to the weakest copy: the acting training is not perfect.
